# Maps and Values

Functions over maps, and functions that inspect any value.

Every function can be called as `f(x, ...)` or as a method, `x.f(...)`. In the signatures, `T` and `U` stand for any type, `T[]` is a list, `?` marks an optional parameter, and `(T, number) => boolean` is a lambda parameter.

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`keys`](#keys) | The keys of a map. |
| [`values`](#values) | The values of a map. |
| [`entries`](#entries) | The { key, value } pairs of a map. |
| [`isEmpty`](#isempty) | Whether a list, text, or map has no items; null is empty. |
| [`type`](#type) | The kind of a value: "null", "boolean", "number", "string", "list", "map", "timestamp", "duration", or "opaque". |
| [`toString`](#tostring) | Renders a value as text, as a template would. |

## keys

The keys of a map.

- `keys({ [key: string]: any }): string[]`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
{ a: 1, b: 2 }.keys() // => ["a", "b"]
```

## values

The values of a map.

- `values({ [key: string]: T }): T[]`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
{ a: 1, b: 2 }.values() // => [1, 2]
```

## entries

The { key, value } pairs of a map.

- `entries({ [key: string]: T }): { key: string, value: T }[]`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
{ a: 1, b: 2 }.entries() // => [{ key: "a", value: 1 }, { key: "b", value: 2 }]
{ a: 1, b: 2 }.entries().map(`${.key}=${.value}`).join("&") // => "a=1&b=2"
```

## isEmpty

Whether a list, text, or map has no items; null is empty.

- `isEmpty(any[] | string | { [key: string]: any } | null): boolean`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
{}.isEmpty() // => true
isEmpty("") // => true
```

## type

The kind of a value: "null", "boolean", "number", "string", "list", "map", "timestamp", "duration", or "opaque".

- `type(any): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
type(1) // => "number"
type("a") // => "string"
type([]) // => "list"
type({}) // => "map"
type(null) // => "null"
type(now()) // => "timestamp"
type(days(1)) // => "duration"
```

## toString

Renders a value as text, as a template would.

- `toString(string | number | boolean | null | timestamp | duration): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
toString(true) // => "true"
`${1.5}` == toString(1.5) // => true
```
